name: review-completed
description: Records the outcome, scope, and supporting evidence of a code review that has finished at any stage of the development workflow.
record_when: Record one entry immediately after a code review concludes — whether it was a self-review, a peer review, an LLM review, an automated gate, or a mix — and before the workflow advances to its next stage; if a review is re-run after changes, record a new entry rather than editing the prior one.

properties.name: reviewId
properties.description: Stable identifier for this review run, unique within the workflow, used to correlate findings, evidence, and any later re-review.

properties.name: workflowStage
properties.description: The workflow stage at which this review was performed.

properties.name: reviewTarget
properties.description: Reference to the artifact under review (commit, diff, pull request, file set, or design document); use an explicit not-applicable marker only when the review had no single artifact.

properties.name: reviewerKind
properties.description: Who or what actually performed the review.

properties.name: reviewer
properties.description: Identifier of the reviewing person, agent, or tool (handle, name, or model id).

properties.name: startedAt
properties.description: When the review began, when distinguishable from its completion.

properties.name: completedAt
properties.description: When the review finished and its verdict was determined.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: Wall-clock time spent on the review from start to finish.

properties.name: outcome
properties.description: The review's verdict — the decision the workflow should act on.

properties.name: maxSeverity
properties.description: Highest severity among the findings raised; use 'none' when the review produced no findings.

properties.name: findingsCount
properties.description: Total number of findings raised, including non-blocking ones.

properties.name: blockingFindingsCount
properties.description: Number of findings that must be resolved before the workflow may proceed.

properties.name: scopeFilesCount
properties.description: Number of files examined; use an explicit not-applicable marker when the target was not file-based.

properties.name: scopeLinesChanged
properties.description: Number of changed lines covered by the review, where measurable; use an explicit not-applicable marker otherwise.

properties.name: automatedChecksPassed
properties.description: Whether all automated checks run as part of the review (tests, linters, static analysis) passed; use an explicit not-applicable marker when none were run.

properties.name: confidence
properties.description: How confident the reviewer is that the scope was covered adequately and the verdict is sound.

properties.name: followUpRequired
properties.description: Whether further action (rework, re-review, or escalation) is required before proceeding.

properties.name: evidence
properties.description: Reference to the stored review output — findings list, report, or transcript — that substantiates the outcome.

properties.name: notes
properties.description: Free-form reviewer commentary, context, or caveats about the review.
